validation_scope: Residual-driven generator validation over multi-layer hypothesis types.  The bypass filters execution lapses, clusters systematic residuals, generates competing trajectories, runs novelty/conflict/scope checks, performs a world-model screen, and validates selected candidates on heldout and negative-control fixtures.
